Also align the codomains in step 3.1: J maps into system⊗label while V maps into label⊗system; specify the factor permutation or use consistent factor order.

For N<M, q is computed as an m-bit Boolean-circuit target, while the raw O_x interface in the local model takes an N-level address register. The reversible-embedding supplier does not provide that conversion, so the raw query on q is unjustified. Specify and uncompute an exact clean routing/encoding into the N-level register, then update the correctness proof; keep its nonoracle cost separate and preserve the one-raw-query action.
